data.summary: Lam Research Corporation (LRCX) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: Further, the use of AI by us, our customers, suppliers, and third-party providers, among others, may also introduce unique vulnerabilities whose existence or exploitation could have a material adverse effect on our business or operations.
In addition, to the extent AI capabilities improve and are increasingly adopted, they may be used to identify vulnerabilities and to implement increasingly sophisticated cybersecurity attacks.
